name: mainline_factorshock_diagnosis_v1
role: Post hoc diagnosis of the already opened FactorShock seed80 development case; no new optimizer, target geometry, source fit or independent confirmation.

common_pool.construction: Stable unique union of the three frozen 13-observation histories: common initial ten first, then each arm online points in arm order. Never select by truth.
common_pool.terminal_actions: For each checkpoint and arm, use only that arm observed indices; zero-paid checkpoint provides prediction diagnostics only.

frozen_assets.initialization: Ten identical paid raw rows in saved order, exactly equal to the original design and cached baseline.
frozen_assets.online_trajectory: Three saved observations per backend in original order; no new adaptive selection.
frozen_assets.frontends: Original V69 complete frontend remains frozen; no new candidate generation this diagnosis.

posterior_replay.full: Each backend starts from its saved zero-paid source prior and replays only its own available raw; verification samples are excluded.
posterior_replay.point_only: Both A/B retain the existing local raw likelihood and mixture updates at the observed strategy; local identity reweighting is allowed for that strategy only. Neither may mutate shared global identity weights or other strategy marginals.
posterior_replay.scope: Retain native response/noise semantics; GP/current use the existing four-head raw posterior and positive-mixture E[exp(eta)]. Report any native marginal-replay difference explicitly.
moments: centered risk mean and epistemic variance
chance-margin components and posterior violation probability
posterior_replay.replay_conditions: No source fit, model patch, prior calibration, representation change or truth-conditioned repair.
posterior_replay.point_only_from_zero: A: For each strategy start from its unchanged zero-paid source-prior marginal; replay only that strategy own raw among all13, leaving all other strategies and their prior global identity weights unchanged. This isolates initialization plus online cross-strategy propagation.
posterior_replay.point_only_after_initial10: B: Start from the same full joint posterior after the common ten initialization rows; process only the three new raw observations with independent per-strategy marginals, leaving other strategies and their initialized identity weights unchanged. This isolates online cross-strategy updates.
posterior_replay.implementation_scope: GP/current compare full with A and B using the existing native mixture likelihood and PointOnlyResponseMixture. Native saved posterior snapshots provide the fixed anchor; any unavailable native checkpoint or exact local marginal replay must be identified rather than replaced by an invented model.

decision_rule.backend: constrained_ts history fixed; no new acquisition
decision_rule.candidate_scope: observed points of the same arm and checkpoint
decision_rule.verification: No new independent verification. Historical frozen primary and deployed results retained separately.
decision_rule.analysis: Compare full and point-only on common pool predictions, observed-only fixed-path terminal ranking and unsampled strategy changes; separate mean, noise and epistemic contributions.
decision_rule.truth_decomposition: Retrospective truth substitutions apply only to objective/risk means and episode noise. Epistemic interventions use a common observed median or saved native variance, never a claimed epistemic truth. CDF saturation is recorded; these are not optimizer performance.

truth_access.reason: Truth was already opened after the previous complete verification barrier; this turn is retrospective diagnosis.
truth_access.timing: Freeze this pool and protocol before scoring; truth only for scoring and decomposition, never posterior updates or case selection.
truth_access.calls: At most one common-pool truth evaluation per unique strategy; record actual helper/function invocation counts separately if more than one primitive is needed.

cost.numerical_replay: Record completed and failed CPU/wall attempts; no target calls may be hidden in replay.

limitations: One already opened development task and three endogenous saved query paths; no independent superiority or causal adaptive-policy gain claim.
Native and newer backends keep their existing different representations/noise machinery; common task and pool align predictions, not model architecture.
FactorShock shared_shock_scale1 matches reused raw; old V69 scheduler default0 is not used.
Current structural source integration retains fixed1024 nodes without numerical precision certification; diagnosis must not quietly tune source models.
comparisons: Full posterior across all backends on exactly the same eighteen policies and available paid checkpoints.
GP/current full versus source-zero point-only A, and initialized10 point-only B, on each backend own fixed thirteen-raw path.
Separate final observed-only ordering, first-paid versus unsampled predictions, native reference, and historical verified deployment.
native_view_scope: Frozen native final posterior on each saved arm history, plus saved initialization parity. No fabricated native intermediate checkpoints.
post_hoc_extensions: Record all paid checkpoints0..13 to isolate first local observation and later cross-policy effects.
Score the fixed set of five policies never observed by each new arm at paid10..13.

After mean/noise diagnosis, replace only terminal constraint noise by saved point-only A/B noise, retaining full risk mean and epistemic variance. Fixed-path decision ablation only; no posterior or source changes.
